title: Cerebus Mothers & Daughters 8 May #158 The Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics 1992
descriptionText: This comic book features the character Cerebus the Aardvark in a story titled "Mothers & Daughters" in issue number 8, published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in May 1992. The artist and writer of this US comic book is Dave Sim. It belongs to the genre of comics and is part of the series title "Cerebus". The comic book is a collectible item for fans of the series and those who enjoy reading comics in general.
